title: design-decided
description: An objection decided by the system engineer or their deputy, by an issue written in your copy: on the releasing group to its owner, for its next version, or on the programme to the programme manager, to release anyway; or why not.

file.description: The issue's path inside the copy: issues/<number>-<group>.vissue.

addressed_to.description: The releasing group's owner, or the programme manager.
